_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 23: 2025-07-30 to 2025-08-19. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says a great acceleration is coming into this fall and everything will change in a twenty four hour period, and reads a viewer letter pointing out that 23 and 24 September is the main event week for the UN.
mentions.quote: into this fall, a great acceleration is coming. In a 24-hour period, everything will change
mentions.falsify_match: A single transformative day in the autumn of 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He stacks the signs: a Holy Week, a blood moon visible to seven billion people on the seventh, the number seven and 7-Eleven which he says is not coincidence, and another major event on the 23rd, calling them shakings to awaken.
mentions.quote: It's not coincidence. 7-Eleven, another major event taking place on on uh the 23rd
mentions.falsify_match: Events of significance on both dates.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither date produces one. The numerology is doing the work here rather than a vision.

mentions.claim_text: He tells people to check themselves, says he is not perfect and nobody there is, that their wind stinks too, and that the Lord said to examine yourself.
mentions.quote: Brennan's not perfect. Nobody's up in here perfect
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: exhortation.

mentions.claim_text: He declares this the greatest hour of the church, with brush arbor churches, major revivals in the country and an amazing outpouring of the Spirit like nothing seen before.
mentions.quote: we will have brush harbor harbor churches and we will have major revivals
mentions.falsify_match: Open air revival meetings spreading across rural America.

mentions.claim_text: He tells parents to get up a couple of minutes earlier to read and claim Psalm 91 over their child before school and to believe it.
mentions.quote: claim Psalms 91 over your child as they go to school
mentions.condition_text: protection conditioned on praying it and believing it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a devotional instruction.

mentions.claim_text: He describes babies gestated outside the mother for nine months because it is inconvenient to spoil her body, says the human connection with the mother is lost, and that Hollywood will grab hold of this in a big way.
mentions.quote: Hollywood's going to grab a hold of this like really crazy
mentions.falsify_match: Artificial gestation reaching commercial use and celebrity adoption.

mentions.claim_text: He says very hard days are coming for some people, a shaking to awaken, with the Lord having warned of a shaking in the heavens with major signs and fearful sights that will bring you to your knees, plus a shaking in the earth, the economy and the political.
mentions.quote: Major signs, fearful sights you will see will bring you to your knee
mentions.falsify_match: All the named domains shaking at once.

mentions.claim_text: He says western culture will not really see the 7 September eclipse but the Middle East, Europe and those regions will, and that this is not a coincidence around the blood moon.
mentions.quote: they're all going to see this major eclipse on this September 7th
mentions.falsify_match: The visibility footprint is a matter of astronomical record and he states it correctly.

mentions.claim_text: In spontaneous prayer he sees fall leaves and the changing of the seasons, with October highlighted and September seen.
mentions.quote: I see October highlighted. I see. I see September
mentions.falsify_match: Something of note across those two months.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing, and no content is attached to the months.

mentions.claim_text: Asked by his own pastor whether what he sees can be delayed, he says they can always pray into something and stop it, and that a lot can be fixed.
mentions.quote: We always can pray into something and stop something
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is the general licence: any vision that fails to arrive was prayed off.

mentions.claim_text: He says he did not even know there was an eclipse but has found out a major eclipse and full blood moon is coming in September that seven billion people will potentially be able to see.
mentions.quote: 7 billion people will be able to see this blood moon that's coming in September
mentions.falsify_match: He is reading an astronomical fact he had not known, not foreseeing it. Worth recording for that.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts being sent to another church in another city, told to sit at the back and then to address the pastor and tell him there is a scandal, and that within six months that church saw it.
mentions.quote: tell him that there there's a scandal. Within six months, that churc
mentions.falsify_match: The church and the scandal are unnamed, so nothing here can be checked.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that cool heads prevail with a hedge around the nation, and that there be an exposing of things concerning Cuba.
mentions.quote: there's an exposing of things concerning Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: A significant disclosure or crisis involving Cuba.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying he is about to do something that has never been done before on this earth but is looking for all hands on deck, and that he saw people wanting to get off the ship.
mentions.quote: I'm about to do something that's never been done before in this earth
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on all hands staying on deck
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no observable criterion, and the all-hands clause explains any shortfall.

mentions.claim_text: He mentions the White House and Marilyn Monroe, says he may be saying too much, and that people must pray for him because it is not just about a Kennedy curse but other things attached, and that he has a mission to finish.
mentions.quote: It's not just about a Kennedy curse. There's more things that are attached
mentions.falsify_match: Harm coming to the figure he is describing, who is not named here.

mentions.claim_text: He says something major is about to happen going into the fall, and repeats an instruction the Lord gave the family a few weeks earlier: watch the first freeze, and asks when the viewer's first freeze is.
mentions.quote: Watch the first freeze. Watch the first freeze
mentions.falsify_match: A major event coinciding with the first hard freeze of the season.

mentions.claim_text: He says economies are in trouble and that he sees Canada's economy in trouble, that how they handle Israel going into September makes it a time to remember, and that he sees British Columbia shaking.
mentions.quote: I see Canada's economy in trouble
mentions.falsify_match: A Canadian economic crisis and a British Columbia earthquake.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord is showing him August, September and a great acceleration of the wealth transfer going into the first frost, and that the Lord distinguished it as not their first frost.
mentions.quote: a great acceleration of the wealth transfer going into the first frost
mentions.time_phrase: August and September into the first frost
mentions.falsify_match: A visible transfer of wealth accelerating into the autumn of 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He sees November with the housing market going up and appearing transparent, the man walking the pig again, then January with lowering taxes written on a sign he was excited to show everybody.
mentions.quote: I saw uh lowering taxes on a sign and he was excited
mentions.falsify_match: Housing rising into November and a tax cut announced in January 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He says the reward is for those who diligently seek God rather than for him, that he may write a check as the distributor of the wealth given him, and that it will go to unlikely people who may not treat you right.
mentions.quote: I may be the distributor of what he the wealth that he gave me
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private provision with a seeking condition.

mentions.claim_text: He describes taxes being lowered with a sign held up and everything looking good for a time, says it is just a season, and that the waterfall is coming.
mentions.quote: It's just a season. You understand? The waterfall is coming
mentions.falsify_match: A tax cut and apparent prosperity followed by a sharp fall.

mentions.claim_text: A word of knowledge naming healing for the arteries and veins in the neck that have been causing dizziness and headaches.
mentions.quote: I see healing for arteries in the nay the neck right here
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable in practice: symptoms common enough that any large audience supplies a match.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him to call a dog home, that he saw the dog run away, and sends angels out right now to bring it back, acknowledging it sounds different.
mentions.quote: the Lord said, Call this dog home. I saw the dog and he ran away
mentions.falsify_match: A viewer reporting a lost dog returning after this. Unusually specific for a word of knowledge.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such report, though the base rate for a lost dog in a large audience is high.

mentions.claim_text: He invites viewers to say what they need now, promises to stand and pray with them, and says nothing is too big for God to forgive however badly they have messed up.
mentions.quote: There's nothing too big for God to forgive
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an appeal.

mentions.claim_text: He describes silos full of body parts held for God's people: arms of every colour and width, legs, kidneys, spleens and all kinds of different eyes.
mentions.quote: black arms, red arms, wide arms, all kinds of parts, legs, uh, kidneys, spleens
mentions.condition_text: available to those who believe him for it
mentions.falsify_match: A documented case of a limb or organ appearing where none existed.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the fire of being newly born again wearing off as time goes, sin creeping back in and things getting hard.
mentions.quote: as time goes, the newness wears off
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: He says Jesus is coming soon, that he keeps his eyes on him with anticipation in his heart for major things for the body of Christ, and keeps himself right by returning to the awe of God.
mentions.quote: I have an anticipation in my heart for major things to take place
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing.

mentions.claim_text: He cites being spewed out for lukewarmness, says you are either all in or not, that they are in the last of the last days, and that it will be as labour pains upon a woman as they step into August.
mentions.quote: we're in the last of the last days, ladies and gentlemen
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an imminence claim with no date.

mentions.claim_text: He says to watch the fig tree going into September, that he had told them it was coming before, corrects himself that the Lord said it rather than him, and that the Lord told him in prayer back in May to watch September.
mentions.quote: The Lord told me in prayer to watch September back in May
mentions.falsify_match: A May 2025 statement in the corpus telling people to watch September, which would make the September framing a real prior call.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such prior statement is found.
